parole.significato: An alcoholic beverage made with rum and water, especially that once issued to sailors of the Royal Navy.
parole.testo: An allusion to Admiral Edward Vernon (nicknamed “Old Grog” after the grogram coat he habitually wore), who in 1740 ordered his sailors' rum to be watered down.
